question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the oath or affirmation by the President?
solution:
The correct answer is __**60**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 60 of the Indian Constitution tells about the Oath and Affirmation of the President of India.__
 
• __Oath or Affirmation by the President__:- Before entering his office, the President has to make and subscribe to an oath or affirmation. In his oath, the President swears:
 
 
• To faithfully execute the office.
 
• To preserve, protect and defend the Constitution and law.
 
• To devote himself to the service and well-being of the people of India.
